instruction_directory.counting_method: Raw committed-LF blob sums with no inter-file separators. Context profiles separately join sources with LF separators.

metadata_accounting.method: All repository skill name/description values plus installed gh-stack name/description, sorted by path and separated by LF; no metadata removals. Personal/plugin catalogs, host framing and unrelated outputs excluded.

context_method: Explicit partial-context UTF-8 bytes/4 ceiling proxies, not actual tokens, activation, billing or latency. Other required global bodies, bindings and command outputs are excluded except the directory profile. Directory profile is all 47 instructions plus catalog, not the selected startup context. Supporting references remain conditional.

inventory.read_policy: Copilot first, complete inventory/frontmatter, current global and task bodies; unchanged already-read guidance reused after comparison.

checks.exactness: pass; complete prefix, 18 Rules, scope, planning/lockfile, gate, references and hosting/fallback compared with pinned raw LF blob

checks.json_shape: pass; duplicate keys rejected; six unique ids, exact case schema and pinned revision checked; definitions only

relative_links_anchors.scope: Local files and installed counterpart anchors verified; remote page freshness not claimed; unchanged external evidence table retained.

configured_markdownlint.limits: Focused configured runner; no application, Docusaurus or canonical build run.

checks.whitespace: pass; git diff --check; all four owned files use LF
checks.protected_scope: pass; exactly one owned instruction and three focused records; all repository skills, AGENTS, custom agents, workflows, source, samples, tests, build inputs unchanged
checks.self_review: pass; all changed instruction lines and authored records inspected against preserved contracts and mappings; no raw move to AGENTS/new skill, unrelated change or behavior-pass claim
checks.skill_schema: pass; quick_validate.py validated both unchanged routed skills

behavior.status: Definitions only; no fresh native or supplied-catalog behavioral assessment executed. No hidden oracle or alternate-model CLI used. Copilot deferred/unverified. Existing skill evidence does not become a fresh consolidation pass.

manifest_method: SHA-256 of sorted path + NUL + raw-content SHA-256 hex + LF records. Repository source blobs are committed LF at the pinned baseline. Installed package hashes cover host files; it is not a repository-pinned package.
